مقدمة

This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, which should be carried 
 out every three years as indicated by Y3 in the title block
المواصفات الفنية للوحدة المائية :
Francis Turbine Max Power
180 MW
Max Head
Speed
100 RPM

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Abd Allah Ismaiel, tested by eng. 
 Atef Sadeq Sayed, accepted by general manager eng. Ahmed Saber Gabr, approved 
 by eng. Abdel-Elnabey Abd-Elghany head sector of high Dam power station and 
 certified by eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman HPGC inspection and quality control general 
 manager & MPIS coordinator

السلامة 
الاحتياطات
يجب إصدار تصريح العمل

The qualified maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety ID category

Wear safety equipment as safety 
 helmet safety shoes breathing mask safety glass ... etc.

سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير 
 مطلوب المحيطة بمنطقة العمل
Completely empty the tunnel

Water level at draft tube not 
 exceed 100 m

Secure closing intake and draft 
 tubes maintenance gates
Switch off F403 automatic
Close the main oil valve no 7
Use lightening 36 V
Use 8 bar service air

العمل ليكون 
نفذت

Drain the governor oil to remove from the system undesirable impurities or 
 compounds which have entered the hydraulic circuits

Oil in the actuator sump should be drained and the sump is inspected for oil 
 contamination of foreign material
Dismantle strain body a dirty filter should be replaced
Remove any of grease and dirt from all linkage pivot points and rods
Lubricate the pivot points and bearings with oil
Inspect all unions and pipe connection to be certain they are tightened
فحص وتنظيف منظمات التدفق ومنظمات الضغط

sections.text: Dismantle the pilot control assembly
Unscrew the fixed bolted and clean all internal parts with benzene
If necessary replace the o-rings oil sealing springs and gasket

يجب أن تكون جميع الأسطح والحواف الداخلية ناعمة ومتجانسة ونظيفة وخالية من الشوائب 
 مقياس الصدأ والشقوق

Check the smooth rotation of oil motor which is used to rotate the transducer 
 pilot valve bushing
Reassemble and joint parts of pilot control assembly

Air should be removed from hydraulic system. For this purpose before filling 
 the system with oil it is necessary to open air vent and it is to be closed 
 when oil appears from it

After reassembly it is important to recenter the transducer before being 
 placed in operation tighten the lower centering screw 07075-75 with 7/76 Allen 
 wrench. Then back the screw off 1-1/2 turns next the centering is done by 
 using 1/8 inch Allen wrench to center the transducer pilot valve plunger

sections.text:
Absence of corrosion notches dents and other defects on surfaces of 
 distribution valve bushing plunger pilot valve bushing and pilot valve plunger

Inspect the pilot valve bushing and plunger in distributing valve and should 
 be checked to ensure there is no friction through full stroke

The speed of oil motor vibrator should be set between 500 and 600 rpm by 
 adjusting the flow regulator, the oil motor eccentric is then adjusted to 
 produce an oscillation of the distributing valve plunger of approximately 1.5 
 mm

Check cable stretch for gate restoring cable this indicated by a change in 
 gate position indication in opening direction when the turbine servomotors are 
 in the fully closed position

The restoring cable is provided with a convenient cable adjustment connection 
 inside the governor cabinet

Check the gate position and gate limit indication for accuracy at the governor 
 indicator adjust for cable stretch if necessary

sections.text:
Follow this procedure in calibrating the gate limit for proper alignment with 
 the gate position deviation of 1% at any given point is considered 
 satisfactory
Make sure that turbine is unwatered and the gate limit is below zero
Place the governor transfer switch in the "manual" position
Block shutdown solenoid out of the way

Set the pilot servomotor at 1/2 stroke using a 0.875" spacer block. To de so 
 raise the gate limit to 100% and place the spacer under the connecting pin 
 (07075-35) at the top of the pilot servomotor Then lower the gate limit 
 control The spacer will stop the pilot servomotor at 1/2 stroke

Adjust the length of the pilot valve connecting link so that the black gate 
 indication hand on the front of the governor is at 50% tighten the connecting 
 link lock nuts

Turn the gate limit control knob clockwise until the gate position (black 
 hand) raises above 50% remove the spacer block
Turn the gate limit knob until the gate limit indicator (red hand) is at 50%

Adjust the length of the vertical gate limit connecting rod (07075-28) until 
 the gate position indication (black hand) is also at 50% tighten the connecting 
 rod lock nuts

Turn the gate limit control so that the red hand is at 10 % record the 
 position of the black hand and note its deviation from 10%

بعد ذلك، أدر مفتاح التحكم في حد البوابة بحيث تكون العقرب الأحمر عند 90% وسجل 
 موضع اليد السوداء ولاحظ انحرافها عن 90%

The deviations recoded in step 9 and 10 will usually be high at one position 
 and low at other If the deviations are greater than = 1% then the gate limit 
 lever eccentric must be adjusted
 The gate limit lever eccentric is adjusted by loosening the hex head screw 
 (07075-234) and nut (07575-229) and then the moving the hex head screw in the 
 slot with the aid of the set screw (07075-23)

The gate position travel on either side of 50% should now be almost equal also 
 with the gate limit (red hand) at 50% the gate position (black hand) should be 
 at 50 
 If the recorded gate position travel on either side of 50% should now be 
 almost equal with the gate limit the governor gate limit control is properly 
 calibrated 
 The gate limit is correctly calibrated when the gate position coincides with 
 the gate limit within 1% throughout the full gate stroke
